project_type: XamOps multi-module platform: Spring Boot (Java) backend microservices + React/Vite frontend + a Go OpenTelemetry supervisor agent. This task touches the xamops-service Spring Boot module and the xamops-agent Go module only.
language: Java 25 (Spring Boot 4.0.x) for the backend; Go 1.25 for the agent.
build_system: Maven multi-module, root pom at /Users/admin/Desktop/xam-latest/XamOps-New/pom.xml. Build one module with -pl xamops-service -am. Go module github.com/xamops/agent at /Users/admin/Desktop/xam-latest/XamOps-New/xamops-agent.
test_framework: JUnit (Surefire) for Java; go test for Go. XamPulse unit tests live under xamops-service/src/test/java/com/xammer/cloud/xampulse. No frontend build is possible here (empty node_modules, npm registry unreachable).
verification_instructions: After each FEAT: (1) compile with the build_command; (2) run the FEAT's targeted tests with -Dtest=<classes>; (3) before declaring done run the full XamPulse suite (test_command) and confirm BUILD SUCCESS with 0 failures. The ONLY acceptable pre-existing failure is AwsPermissionCatalogKubernetesTest.logsDegradesKubernetes_andKeepsItsOtherFeatures in com.xammer.cloud.permissions (unrelated, recorded in prior slices). For any Go edit: cd xamops-agent && go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./internal/xampulse/...  . If a XamPulse DTO changes, regenerate contract samples: mvn -B -q -pl xamops-service test -Dtest=XamPulseContractSampleTest -Dxampulse.contract.update=true, then re-run WITHOUT the flag so the pinned samples are committed as data.
snapshot_or_generated_files: Contract samples under xamops-service/src/test/resources/xampulse/contract-samples/*.json are generated by XamPulseContractSampleTest; regenerate with -Dxampulse.contract.update=true only when a DTO changes, then re-run without the flag. No other generated files.
environment_constraints: No real ClickHouse, S3, Redis, Postgres/Flyway, nginx, AWS or browser is available; all writes/reads must be unit-tested through fakes/seams. Do NOT start servers. Do NOT run the full xamops-service suite expecting the permissions test to pass. Do NOT touch the unrelated uncommitted GCP/Dockerfile changes in the working tree. Do NOT read, import or compare the Beta Observability or OpenObserve code. No commit/push/merge.
contribution_requirements: Every XamPulse stereotype bean is @ConditionalOnProperty(name="xampulse.enabled", havingValue="true") and @Service/@Component named xp<ClassName> (e.g. @Service("xpBaselineJob")) — enforced by XamPulseBeanNamingTest/XamPulseWiringTest. New scheduled jobs gate on SchedulingEnvironmentConfig.isSchedulingEnabled() and must swallow ClickHouse errors (log e.getClass().getSimpleName() only, never params) and continue. Every ClickHouse read is built by TenantScopedQueryBuilder and run by ClickHouseExecutor (single tenant per statement, tenant_id predicate first, tenant ids are the first bound params); the executor rejects anything else. Writes go through the writer Hikari pool only. New ClickHouse DDL continues V008+ and NEVER edits V001..V007; new Flyway continues V20261030_* and never edits shipped files. Secrets from env only.
key_patterns: Scheduled job model: service/alert/AlertEvaluator.java and service/archive/ArchiveWriterJob.java (@Scheduled + isSchedulingEnabled() guard + per-account try/catch). Scheduled ClickHouse read model: service/setup/ClickHouseTelemetryProbe.java (executor.queryEach over QueryScope). Write seams today: ClickHouseDdl (DDL) and ClickHouseMutations (ALTER) in service/platform — NEITHER does parameterised INSERT, so a new ClickHouseWrites/JdbcClickHouseWrites seam is required and both use the writer pool (ClickHouseConnections.writer()). Query builder: service/query/TenantScopedQueryBuilder.java (add methods there; metricSeries supports groupBy label keys and label filters; see baseline(), latestMetrics(), metricSeries(), events()). Host views: service/query/HostQueryService.java (summary() currently queries only 4 series). Rollup tables: xp_metrics_1m/5m/1h (AggregatingMergeTree, *Merge functions), xp_metric_points (raw points, has labels Map and process labels at T2), xp_log_volume_1m (SummingMergeTree rows/bytes), xp_baseline (ReplacingMergeTree(updated_at) keyed tenant,metric,instance,hour_of_week — ALREADY EXISTS in V005), xp_events (MergeTree, ALREADY EXISTS in V004), xp_usage_daily (Postgres JPA entity XpUsageDaily, unique key cloud_account_id,day,signal,source). BaselineMath (service/insight) already computes median/MAD per hour-of-week and is unit-tested. Frontend Resource 360 series-key convention (components/XamPulse/hosts/Resource360Drawer.tsx): system.cpu.utilization | system.cpu.utilization{state=steal} | {state=iowait} | per-core system.cpu.utilization{cpu=N} | system.memory.utilization | system.paging.utilization | system.filesystem.utilization{mountpoint=/x} | system.disk.io{direction=read|write} | system.network.io{direction=receive|transmit}. XpProcessRow(pid,name,user?,cpuPct,memPct,memBytes?,threads?). The Go agent already enables cpu/load/memory/paging/filesystem/disk/network hostmetrics scrapers (xampulse/templates/linux.yaml.tmpl, rendered by internal/xampulse/config_render.go); process.* only at T2.
